desc: A satirical comedy exploring the world of infomercials and the power of persuasion. 'Teleshopping' humorously critiques consumerism while providing light-hearted entertainment.

title: Kovilpatti Veeralatchmi
desc: The movie follows Veeralakshmi, a brave woman fighting against untouchability and casteism in her village, enduring torture for being an untouchable, yet striving for justice.

title: Ragini Ips
desc: Police officer Ragini fights corruption, opposing a local MLA and his son, who plots to assault her in revenge.

title: Soggade Chinni Nayana
desc: Satya, a widow, calls upon the spirit of her late husband, Rangaraju, to save their son's marriage, only to uncover the bitter truth behind his own death in the process.

title: Naagavalli
desc: Emperor Raja Naga Bhairava and Chandramukhi are age-old enemies. A girl appears possessed, sparking eerie events in a man's house. Psychiatrist Dr. Vijay sets out to unravel the mystery.

title: Maruthu
desc: Maruthu is a fun action flick featuring Vishal as a hardworking laborer, exploring his heartfelt bond with his grandmother amidst challenges in their rural life.
